title: TP-Link Tapo C410 Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit 2-Pack $89 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: TP-Link Tapo C410 Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit 2-Pack $89 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[Iamgonnabuythat] Also, d210 doorbell at $74 and hub h500 at 199 sale. Just bought one before the deal.
[dbell] If you have the h500 hub, it can record events, not 24/7 as far as I'm aware.
[zooby] Does a 2 pack mean '2 cameras plus 2 solar panels'? Thanks
[theguyrules] I’ve had some Eufy cameras for 5 years now (Eufycam 2c) but they seem to be getting worse at detection. How long does it take to pull up video for these? Our wired Tapo cameras are instant but our battery Tapo doorbell takes 5 sec sometimes.
[EitherWayUp] Their cameras are pretty good, just got a set recently. But I agree, the doorbell does lag a bit unfortunately.
[Touse19] These ones can be pretty hit and miss with what events they wake up to, a fair amount of recording delay
People are often half way up my driveway before it starts recording.
I've found the powered ones are much better if you can install them.
[theguyrules] Yeah ok sounds like the same as my Eufy ones then. I guess that’s just going to be the catch with battery/solar powered cams.
One day I’ll get Ethernet run outside for PoE. Maybe.
[Groovyuvi] Can you use these with frigate for 24/7 recording?
[Masakari] You cannot. They don't support an rtsp or onvif stream.
[Regie69] We're sorry. The item Tapo TP-Link Smart Home Solar-Powered Security Camera Kit, Wireless, 2K 3MP, IP65, Color Night Vision, Free Smart AI Person Detection, Notification, microSD Card Slot, App Control (Tapo C410 KIT) is no longer available from the seller you selected. To see if it's available from another seller, click here to return to the item's product detail page.
[ozdavo] Thanks, picked up 2 kits (4 cameras) to complement the existing camera and H500 hub.
Anyone recommend some cheap endurance micro SD cards and a cheap hd for the hub?
[try2bhelpful] We looked at SD cards from Centrecom and then price matched at Officeworks. Might be somewhere to start.
[arescarti42] These Tapo camera deals are annoying. They seem to go out of stock almost immediately whenever they come up.
Beginning to think it is just cheap advertising rather than a genuine deal.
[try2bhelpful] I got a pair with the last deal. You just have to be quick.
[spy] How do you know when they're on other than being on OzB?
[Lt Frank Drebin] Do these have RTSP stream so you can direct record to a NVR?
